newsitem.title: USA: Cable Design agrees to buy Dearborn.
newsitem.headline: Cable Design agrees to buy Dearborn.

text.p: Cable Design Technologies Inc said Thursday it agreed with one of the partners of Dearborn Wire and Cable LP to buy its assets together with those of Dearborn affiliates, Dearborn West LP and Thermax Wire LP.
Dearborn and its affiliates have about 850 employees and fiscal 1996 sales of about $85 million, Cable Design said.
Dearborn Wire and Cable LP is an Illinois-based manufacturer and distributor of high performance wire and cable and assemblies.
Terms of the proposed acquisitons were not disclosed.
